profile_text.body:
Chegg is a publicly traded education technology company, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Santa Clara, that describes itself as providing 24/7 homework help and study support across more than 50 subjects. Its site presents the service as combining step-by-step academic guidance, real experts, and student feedback to help users work through difficult coursework. Subscriptions are offered under the Chegg Study and Chegg Study Pack plans, and the company notes that certain partner benefits are included with those subscriptions at no additional cost.

The company's tracked AI product is CheggMate, an AI-powered study assistant positioned to deliver academic help, with noted considerations around student data handling, content accuracy, and honor code implications. Chegg trades on a public exchange under the ticker CHGG and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001364954. No litigation or MCP server presence is recorded in the held data.
